description: Source code implementing LoRaWAN application layer clock synchronization, including handling of clock sync commands, serialization, and periodic resynchronization.

methods.name: clock_sync_serialize_device_time
methods.description: Serializes device uptime plus offset into buffer as 4-byte integer.

methods.name: clock_sync_package_callback
methods.description: Handles incoming clock sync commands and responds accordingly.

methods.name: clock_sync_app_time_req
methods.description: Sends an AppTimeReq message to synchronize clock.

methods.name: clock_sync_resync_handler
methods.description: Periodic handler to request clock resynchronization with jitter.

methods.name: lorawan_clock_sync_get
methods.description: Retrieves current GPS time if synchronized.

methods.name: lorawan_clock_sync_run
methods.description: Initializes and starts the clock sync process.
